OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_DURATION_PERIOD.description: The period of time to await between two runs of the connector (ISO 8601 duration, minimum 1 minute).

OCD_IMPORT_DATALAKE.description: Whether to ingest indicators collections from Datalake.

OCD_IMPORT_THREAT_LIBRARY.description: Whether to ingest the latest entries of the Datalake Threat Library (Malware, Intrusion Set, Tools, Attack Patterns, Vulnerabilities, ...).

OCD_IMPORT_WORLDWATCH.description: Whether to ingest World Watch reports.

OCD_DATALAKE_ENV.description: Advanced setting - Datalake environment to use: `prod` or `preprod`.

OCD_DATALAKE_TOKEN.description: Long Term Token used to access Datalake API, used by `OCD_IMPORT_DATALAKE`, `OCD_IMPORT_THREAT_LIBRARY`, `OCD_WORLDWATCH_IMPORT_INDICATORS` and `OCD_WORLDWATCH_IMPORT_THREAT_ENTITIES`. If all of them are disabled, set a placeholder such as a random string or `NO_PASSWORD`.

OCD_DATALAKE_QUERIES.description: JSON array of Datalake search query hashes to ingest, e.g. `[{"query_hash":"<hash>","label":"<label>"}]`. Required when `OCD_IMPORT_DATALAKE` is enabled.

OCD_DATALAKE_CREATE_OBSERVABLES.description: Whether to create observables from indicators.

OCD_DATALAKE_IGNORE_UNSCORED_INDICATORS.description: Whether to skip Datalake indicators that do not have any score.

OCD_DATALAKE_IGNORE_WHITELISTED_INDICATO.description: Whether to skip Datalake indicators that are whitelisted.

OCD_DATALAKE_FALLBACK_SCORE.description: Score used for Datalake indicators without any score, when `OCD_DATALAKE_IGNORE_UNSCORED_INDICATORS` is disabled.

OCD_DATALAKE_ADD_TAGS_AS_LABELS.description: Whether to add Datalake tags as labels to the imported indicators.

OCD_DATALAKE_ADD_SCORES_AS_LABELS.description: Whether to add Datalake threat scores as labels to the imported indicators.

OCD_DATALAKE_ADD_SCORE.description: Whether to add score to the imported indicators (overwrite existing).

OCD_DATALAKE_ADD_TLP.description: Whether to add a TLP marking to the imported indicators (overwrite existing).

OCD_DATALAKE_ADD_EXTREF.description: Whether to add external references to the imported indicators.

OCD_DATALAKE_ADD_SUMMARY.description: Whether to add a threat summary as a note to the imported indicators.

OCD_DATALAKE_ADD_RELATED.description: Whether to import objects from the Threat Library related to imported indicators, such as malwares, campaigns, etc.

OCD_DATALAKE_ADD_SIGHTINGS.description: Whether to import positive sightings from Datalake.

OCD_DATALAKE_ADD_CREATEDBY.description: Whether to add a reference to the 'Orange Cyberdefense' organization as author of OpenCTI objects.

OCD_DATALAKE_ZIP_FILE_PATH.description: Advanced setting - Path where temporary ZIP files are saved.

OCD_DATALAKE_ZIP_FILE_DELETE.description: Advanced setting - Whether to delete temporary ZIP files after processing.

OCD_DATALAKE_CURATE_LABELS.description: Advanced setting - Adapt Datalake CTI tags as STIX labels.

OCD_DATALAKE_THREAT_ACTOR_AS_INTRUSION_S.description: Advanced setting - Transform Threat Actor objects from Datalake to Intrusion Set objects.

OCD_WORLDWATCH_API_KEY.description: World Watch API key, used by `OCD_IMPORT_WORLDWATCH`. If it is disabled, set a placeholder such as a random string or `NO_PASSWORD`.

OCD_WORLDWATCH_IMPORT_INDICATORS.description: Whether to import indicators from Datalake related to imported reports.

OCD_WORLDWATCH_IMPORT_INDICATORS_LOOKBAC.description: Advanced setting - How far (in seconds) to look back for indicators related to imported reports, based on their update time.

OCD_WORLDWATCH_IMPORT_THREAT_ENTITIES.description: Whether to import objects from the Threat Library related to imported reports, such as malwares, campaigns, etc.

OCD_WORLDWATCH_START_DATE.description: Start date for the import of World Watch reports.

OCD_RESET_STATE.description: Advanced setting - Force the use of the start date from the config instead of the state saved in OpenCTI.
